properties.displayName: Web Session ASIM parser for Salesforce Real-Time Event Monitoring
properties.query:
let parser = (
    disabled: bool = false
    , pack: bool = false
) {
    let UserTypeLookup = datatable (UserType: string, SrcUserType: string)[
        "Standard", "Regular",
        "Guest", "Guest",
        "AutomatedProcess", "System",
        "CsnOnly", "Other",
        "CspLitePortal", "Other",
        "CustomerSuccess", "Other",
        "PowerCustomerSuccess", "Other",
        "PowerPartner", "Other",
        "SelfService", "Other"
    ];
    SalesForceRealTimeEventMonitoring_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where EventType in ("LightningUriEvent", "UriEvent")
    // UriEvent without RecordId is not a page view, no URL available
    | where EventType != "UriEvent" or isnotempty(RecordId)
    | project-rename EventOriginalType = EventType
    // SalesforceDomain is missing in some workspaces
    | extend _SalesforceDomain = column_ifexists("SalesforceDomain", "")
    | extend EventResult = case(
        PolicyOutcome in ("Block", "MeteringBlock"), "Failure",
        OperationStatus == "Success", "Success",
        OperationStatus in ("Failure", "Fail"), "Failure",
        "NA"
    )
    | extend Url = case(
        EventOriginalType == "LightningUriEvent", PageUrl,
        // Classic record pages are served at /<RecordId>
        EventOriginalType == "UriEvent" and isnotempty(RecordId),
            strcat("/", RecordId),
        ""
    )
    | extend
        _DomainFQDN = tostring(parse_url(_SalesforceDomain).Host)
        // SourceIp is "Salesforce.com IP" for requests made inside Salesforce
        , _IsSrcIp = isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SourceIp))
            or isnotempty(parse_ipv6(SourceIp))
    | extend _DomainHostname = tostring(split(_DomainFQDN, ".")[0])
    | lookup UserTypeLookup on UserType
    | extend
        HttpReferrer = iff(
            PreviousPageUrl startswith "/",
            strcat(_SalesforceDomain, PreviousPageUrl),
            PreviousPageUrl
        )
        , HttpUserAgent = iff(UserAgent == "N/A", "", UserAgent)
        , SrcIpAddr = iff(_IsSrcIp, SourceIp, "")
        , SrcDescription = iff(_IsSrcIp, "", SourceIp)
        , SrcDeviceType = case(
            DevicePlatform has_any ("PHONE", "TABLET"), "Mobile Device",
            DevicePlatform has "DESKTOP", "Computer",
            isnotempty(DevicePlatform), "Other",
            ""
        )
        , AdditionalFields = iff(
            pack
            , bag_pack(
                "QueriedEntities", QueriedEntities
                , "SessionKey", SessionKey
                , "SessionLevel", SessionLevel
                , "LoginHistoryId", LoginHistoryId
                , "AppName", AppName
                , "RecordId", RecordId
                , "Name", Name
                , "PageStartTime", PageStartTime
                // Time since page start, not network duration
                , "Duration", Duration
                , "EffectivePageTime", EffectivePageTime
                , "PreviousPageAppName", PreviousPageAppName
                , "PreviousPageEntityType", PreviousPageEntityType
                , "PreviousPageEntityId", PreviousPageEntityId
                , "DevicePlatform", DevicePlatform
                , "DeviceSessionId", DeviceSessionId
                , "OsName", OsName
                , "OsVersion", OsVersion
                , "PolicyOutcome", PolicyOutcome
            )
            , dynamic({})
        )
    | project-rename
        EventOriginalUid = EventIdentifier
        , EventOriginalSubType = Operation
        , EventOriginalResultDetails = OperationStatus
        , SrcUserId = UserId
        , SrcUsername = UserNameDetail
        , SrcOriginalUserType = UserType
        , NetworkSessionId = LoginKey
        , UrlOriginal = PageUrl
    | extend
        EventStartTime = coalesce(EventDate, TimeGenerated)
        , SrcUsernameType = case(
            isempty(SrcUsername), "",
            SrcUsername has "@", "UPN",
            "Simple"
        )
    | project
        TimeGenerated
        , Type
        , EventCount = toint(1)
        , EventStartTime
        , EventEndTime = EventStartTime
        , EventType = "WebServerSession"
        , EventResult
        , EventOriginalResultDetails
        , EventOriginalType
        , EventOriginalSubType
        , EventOriginalUid
        , EventUid = _ItemId
        , EventSeverity = iff(EventResult == "Failure", "Low", "Informational")
        , EventProduct = "Real-Time Event Monitoring"
        , EventVendor = "Salesforce"
        , EventSchema = "WebSession"
        , EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0"
        , Dvc = coalesce(_DomainFQDN, "Salesforce")
        , DvcFQDN = _DomainFQDN
        , DvcHostname = _DomainHostname
        , DvcDomain = substring(_DomainFQDN, strlen(_DomainHostname) + 1)
        , DvcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_DomainFQDN), "FQDN", "")
        , Url
        , UrlOriginal
        , HttpReferrer
        , HttpUserAgent
        , UserAgent = HttpUserAgent
        , Dst = coalesce(_DomainFQDN, "Salesforce")
        , DstFQDN = _DomainFQDN
        , DstHostname = _DomainHostname
        , Hostname = _DomainHostname
        , DstDomain = substring(_DomainFQDN, strlen(_DomainHostname) + 1)
        , DstDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_DomainFQDN), "FQDN", "")
        , DstAppName = "Salesforce"
        , DstAppType = "SaaS application"
        , SrcIpAddr
        , Src = SrcIpAddr
        , IpAddr = SrcIpAddr
        , SrcDescription
        , SrcDeviceType
        , SrcUserId
        , SrcUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUserId), "SalesforceId", "")
        , SrcUsername
        , SrcUsernameType
        , SrcUserType
        , SrcOriginalUserType
        , User = SrcUsername
        , NetworkSessionId
        , SessionId = NetworkSessionId
        , AdditionalFields
};
parser(disabled = disabled, pack = pack)
